text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I knew it wouldn't be easy to find
them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My curiosity gets the better of me when
I hear
Zenno Rob Roy let out a small
sigh, and I ask her
what's the matter.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm trying to find the owner of this

bookmark.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I found it in a library book. I'm
thinking it
belongs to the person who
borrowed it before
me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's such a lovely pressed flower
bookmark. I'm
sure this person is a big
book lover.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate for them to be without their
bookmark,
which is why I want to make
sure I get it back to
them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Plus, they're a fan of the cult classic Run, Umas, so they must be a kindred spirit. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well... Um, I'm the student library
assistant,
so...
choice_data_list: It might be best to check with the...
What's the story in that book about?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait... That's right! I can look at the
loans system!
I'm sure I can find their
name that way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy uses her library assistant 
privileges to access the loan data to find
out who
the last Umamusume to borrow
the book was.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to talk to everyone
who's recently checked out this book,
and we can find
who this bookmark
belongs to.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a lot of work to go around the
campus,
but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm excited to meet someone who's read
the same
book as me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Oh, it'd be so fun if we could
discuss the
book and share our thoughts
on it together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a passionate coming-of-age story
that talks about the trials and
tribulations of an
Umamusume who runs
mid-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is a gentle yet naive
Umamusume named Umas. However,
she's not good at speaking and gets
misunderstood a lot. She's always alone
during practices.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's only one person she can call a
friend, but unlike Umas, her friend is
super cheerful and
popular and has a
bright future ahead of her...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But one day, tragedy befalls her best
friend. She suffers a serious injury from
an unforeseen
accident and can never
race again...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When her friend announces her
retirement, she entrusts Umas with a
heavy promise... "You must
carry on my
dream for me."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic! That's one of the most famous scenes in the book, but I still can't help crying when I think about it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Umas ends up taking the Fall
Senior
Triple Crown in her best friend's
stead.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? It's one of my
absolute
favorites.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please give it a read! I'd
love to
discuss it with you after you're
done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy's eyes sparkle with
expectation as
she looks at me.
